children: China IT solutions provider's H1 operating income more than doubled yr/yr
Net loss attributable to shareholders widened yr/yr
Board does not recommend interim dividend for the period
Group will deepen cross-border logistics R&D and demonstration projects to build an end-to-end cargo-tracking information system
INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY DISPOSAL – Operating income more than doubled, primarily due to about RMB178 mln of income from disposing of industrial-park land and properties
INPUT-COST PRESSURE – Excluding the disposal, gross margin fell to 16.60% from 19.40% as copper volatility and computing-capacity demand lifted cable, storage and core-component costs
ONE-OFF EARNINGS HIT – Higher finance costs for interest on occupied funds and an investment-property disposal loss cut earnings by about RMB10 mln combined
